status: Interactive design prototype; financial integrations pending
scope: Shared eight-asset catalog and real icon selectors
Independent RWA access indicators and exact same-tab source links

chart: All seven base assets are quoted in USDC; USDC is fixed and excluded from the picker.
TradingView Lightweight Charts 5.2.1: wheel/pinch zoom, pan, draggable price/time axes, crosshair, Auto, Log and Fit.
Real timestamped underlying reference/oracle history; Aquarius swap OHLCV for AQUA and daily Spiko NAV with ECB FX for EUTBL.
Soroswap current price preferred; Aquarius price fallback. USDC normalization uses observed prices rather than a fixed dollar peg.
Every asset renders candlesticks; oracle OHLC aggregates finer observations and EUTBL uses labeled daily NAV candles. No invented observations, volume, empty-period or future candles.
Polling preserves zoom; changing assets/intervals cancels obsolete requests and removes old data. Saved fallback history is explicitly dated.
positions: My positions heading; positions / pending / history tabs
USD notional with valuation timestamp and currency assumption
Average entry, mark and signed unrealized P&L / percentage
Full-position close enters the shared exact-input swap review

production_contract.candles: Canonical pair/network, interval, UTC timestamp, OHLC decimal strings, base-asset volume, source and coverage gaps
production_contract.positions: Account/network/asset identity, exact owned and spendable quantity, valuation in USD with price/fx timestamps, cost-basis method and fee coverage, unknown basis, pending actions
production_contract.close: Prepare a fresh sale of exact spendable quantity; preserve fee/reserve constraints, route bounds, receiver, expiry and policy revision. Shared review and wallet signature required; reconcile only confirmed receipt.

vaults.prototype: Explicit illustrative profiles for visual filtering; not validated product ratings. Unavailable product is Unrated.
vaults.production: Return versioned product-risk methodology, evidence, observation time and an unclassified state. Never infer safety from yield or exit timing.
vaults.preserved: Underlying yield breakdown and pre-action withdrawal terms on product detail/review.

credit.page_header: Credit label, serif title, concise purpose and contextual Ask Nest action
credit.desktop: Centered two-panel builder with maximum combined width 1180px and 24px gap. Left term rail / right editor use 1.15fr / 0.85fr. The comparison table retains the workspace width.
credit.term_rail: Five 68px selection controls, 12px radius, active orange outline; selected values remain visible. Compare and Reset follow the rail.
credit.editor: Minimum 540px desktop study, 24px padding. Field-specific asset identity, amount and explanatory content. Apply action at the bottom.
credit.comparison: Dense table preserving all three venue results and exclusion reasons. Numeric values right aligned, provenance/assumptions below.
credit.mobile: Below 801px of workspace, stack the term rail and editor with a maximum width of 640px. Comparison retains contained horizontal scrolling.

rwa.classification: Three independent dimensions, never mutually exclusive. Distributed/Represented is not access metadata.
rwa.known_kyc: Issuer access requirement supported by issuer documentation; does not label every secondary trade as KYC-gated.
rwa.mint_redeem: Reported issuer subscription and redemption capability, with settlement timing and eligibility still source-bound. Not an executable Nest route.
rwa.dex: Two-sided public Stellar XLM orderbook observed for the exact classic asset code and issuer. Not an amount-specific quote or authorization check.
rwa.unknown: No verified evidence remains ?, not false/no. Empty XLM books do not exclude other markets or AMMs.

invariants: No live wallet, signing or transaction path added
No realized P&L inferred from current price
Sampled-price OHLC remains labeled; unobserved intraperiod extremes and volume are never inferred
Risk fixture labels do not establish actual safety
RWA issuer access does not imply public or instant redemption
DEX observations do not establish account authorization or executable size

asset_selection.icons: Real, locally bundled brand images; AQUA alias resolves Aquarius, SolvBTC image acquired through Chrome. Source URLs and hashes in logo-provenance.json.
asset_selection.vaults: USDC and XLM retained; six requested assets added. Checkbox + icon + symbol in a compact two-column grid. Filters combine and reset; no matching fixture produces an empty state, not a fabricated vault.
asset_selection.trade: Seven searchable base assets; fixed USDC quote, including after reversing the ticket. Escape/Close restores focus.
asset_selection.quotes: Asset or direction changes clear quote amounts and review bounds. Sample execution quotes remain separate from the real chart/reference feeds.
asset_selection.chart_lifecycle: Intervals and asset changes abort obsolete requests; chart/observer/listeners are disposed on unmount. Direction reversal preserves the base/USDC chart and zoom.
asset_selection.production: Catalog entries must bind canonical network/issuer/SAC/contract and decimals; source availability, wallet eligibility and amount-specific routing are checked independently before review.
